primary.title: Too much AI exposure? Can Apple be the diversification play in your portfolio? What Indian investors need to know
primary.summary: Investors wary of heavy AI spending by US tech giants are turning to Apple, which offers tech exposure with lower risk. Apple shares rose 7% while spending only $6.8 billion on capex, unlike major competitors investing $30-$54 billion quarterly.
